svg.text: SQL Joins and Windows – Visual Guide
Dotnet · D27 · Grain first, then join, then window without collapsing
Customers → orders → lines. Grain is the trap.
State the grain before the second JOIN — lines multiply orders.
Join preserves. Group collapses. Window keeps rows.
Sum at the line grain, rank customers.
JOIN Orders o ON o.CustomerId = c.Id
JOIN OrderLine l ON l.OrderId = o.Id
grain = one row per customer — sum lines, then rank
